name: Nanami Mitsuki
source:
She is your childhood friend. You used to be very close, but failed to keep in contact as the years passed.

She suddenly received a pair of tickets for a trip and invited you to go together.

She's upbeat, energetic, and the star of the swimming club. She might be girlier than her tomboyish looks let on.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4260270/Stranded_with_You/]Steam[/url]]
